correctness.rationale: For contracted rotations x→{lambda x+delta}, with delta uniformly sampled, Laurent–Nogueira's exact coprime p/q rational plateau width is w_q=(1-lambda)^2 lambda^(q-1)/(1-lambda^q), independent of numerator p. The special q=1 interval length 1-lambda agrees. Writing h=-log lambda gives w_q=2(cosh h-1)/(exp(hq)-1); grouping phi(q) numerators yields P(Q=q) with total sum one by sum_{d|n}phi(d)=n. Summatory totient 3X²/pi²+O(X log X), partial summation and uniform short/large scaled-period tail bounds produce hQ⇒density (6/pi²)t/(exp t-1) on t>0, whose integral is 1. For each q≥2, number of reduced numerators ≤u q is u phi(q)+O(tau(q)); weighted error O(h log²(1/h)) proves angular equidistribution and asymptotic independence R and hQ. Uniform exponential tails imply convergence of all nonnegative integer moments to 6 Gamma(r+2) zeta(r+2)/pi². Independently computed totient-normalized periods at h=.15,.05,.01,.003 (up to 12,666 denominators) with total mass deviations below 1e-8 and mean approaching 12 zeta(3)/pi²; exact divisor identities verified for n≤149. These are finite sanity checks; the analytic argument covers all h→0 and all claimed moments.
